transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, robotic palletizer P-4 stopped during the morning shift, and we have a manual palletizing station available in the finished-goods warehouse as a temporary alternative. We also have an urgent outbound order scheduled for the end of the week. Before I settle on a recovery plan, I'd like to hear from each of you. Maintenance, can you walk us through the operational situation with P-4? Logistics, what are the shipment requirements we need to meet? And Safety, are there any isolation or safety considerations we need to account for with either the repair or the manual station? Let's get everything on the table so we can move forward quickly.

transcript.text: Thanks, Mara. I inspected P-4 this morning and can give you the maintenance picture. I found a damaged gearbox bearing — that's the root cause of the stoppage. The good news is we have the replacement seal stocked on site, so no waiting on parts. The repair will take exactly 6 hours, and it requires exactly 6 lockout points to do safely. One thing to note: my inspection report is complete but still awaiting my supervisor's signoff, so I'll need that signoff before we can formally proceed. I'll share the specific details on the bearing damage and repair requirements now so everyone has the full picture.

transcript.text: I've confirmed from the carrier booking and warehouse count that exactly 800 pallets must be staged by Friday at 15:00. I haven't entered the confirmed count into the recovery board yet, but everyone needs to know this constraint now.

transcript.text: Thanks, Mara. On the safety side, I need to flag a critical isolation requirement for P-4's repair. My safety review confirmed that the repair requires an authorized electrician to verify zero energy at all six lockout points and record that verification before maintenance starts. This requirement is not yet attached to the work order because the incident review remains open, but it must be included in the recovery plan before any repair work begins. Without this verification step, we cannot safely proceed with the lockout on P-4.
